novelty_search.nearest_result: Deep resid9 alone reproduces 99.7%/100.1% of the localized L9 local-value route, but its internal block8 entry, attention update, and MLP update have not been causally separated on the cross-task carrier outcome.
novelty_search.new_question: Is the deep resid9 carrier state already present at block8 entry, or freshly written by attention8 or MLP8?

population: The same 16 matched cross-task A1 pairs, both orientations, task-indexed H1/H4 carrier groups, and recipient-native L9 routing.

factorial.block8_identity: x9 = z8 + attn8 + mlp8, where z8 is block8's post-lambda mixed input and attn8/mlp8 are the exact native module outputs. The block9 deep input is block9.lambdas[0]*x9.
factorial.arms: Evaluate all eight subsets of scaled z8, attn8, and mlp8 through RMS and fixed L9 c_v with block9 direct x0 excluded; form side-native normalized carrier differences and insert them at recipient H1/H4 before c_proj.
factorial.capture: The RMS-call/c_v adjacency captures z8 and z9; forward hooks capture attn8 and mlp8 outputs. Exact x9/deep9 and joint-V9 closure are required.
factorial.identification_boundary: z8 includes every computation through block7 and block8's own x0 mixing. This test localizes only whether block8's two fresh module updates are necessary.
factorial.no_rescue: No component, layer, RMS rule, carrier role, arm, head, row, orientation, or threshold changes after execution.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_block_: Hashes/capability pass; x9/deep9 recombination, joint deep-V9, local-content, source reconstruction, Möbius efficiency, finiteness, and coverage errors are <=1e-4.
predictions.pred_b_deep_route_recurrence: The all-component arm remains within 0.05 of deep-input recoveries 0.34396155730965494 and 0.184366512527354 with direction fraction 1.0.
predictions.pred_c_state_preexists_block8_updates: z8 has positive Shapley contribution, exceeds attn8 and mlp8 individually in both orientations, and its single arm retains >=0.75 of all components with direction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_each_block8_update_is_nonessentia: Both leave-one-update arms, z8+attn8 and z8+mlp8, retain >=0.75 of all components with direction >=0.75 in both orientations.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 18 transformer forwards/288 examples plus 16 disclosed L9 c_v component batch evaluations, 16 subset-orientation arms, zero fit/search/backward/update.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: the carrier state predominantly predates block8's fresh attention and MLP updates.
terminal.null: Instrument and deep-route recurrence pass but the preexisting-state or nonessential-update prediction misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, capture, exact closure, recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
